subject: Live tech session — inference runtime & topology review (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Harper Nguyen <harper@aquariumhealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Live tech session — inference runtime & topology review (post-discovery)

Hi Harper,

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday — good context on your batch inference patterns and the multi-tenant privacy constraints. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute live technical session to walk through:

- Current inference topology and where model serving would fit into Aquarium Health's pipelines
- Latency & batch sizing tradeoffs for the 99th percentile targets you shared
- KV cache / cold-start behavior and warmup strategies for nightly jobs
- Security / network setup (VPC peering, SSO, and audit logs)

Proposed days/times (PST):
- Tue Feb 24, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Feb 24, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Feb 25, 09:00–10:00

I've attached a short preliminary agenda and our SOC 2 Q&A that Tessa will review. Can you confirm which slot works, and who from your side should join (ops, procurement, security)?

If those windows don't work, share two alternatives and we'll do our best to align.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: prelim-agenda.md (text/markdown), aquarium-soc2-answers.pdf (pdf)
From: Harper Nguyen <harper@aquariumhealth.com>

Cc: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@aquariumhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — that agenda looks great. Quick note on attendees: please add Daniel (CC'd) from procurement and Lina (security lead, lina.security@aquariumhealth.com) — I'll introduce Lina in my calendar invite once we lock a time.

For the times you listed the only slot that could work for our engineering team is Tue Feb 24, 14:00–15:00 PST, but we also have a recurring sync at the top of the hour that might run over. Could we instead try 14:30–15:30 PST? If not, Wed Feb 25 09:00 PST is the fallback.

Also, can you confirm whether you'll cover network diagram examples for VPC peering and any required firewall rules? That's high priority for our infra team.

—Harper

Aquarium Health

Thanks for the quick reply, Harper. 14:30–15:30 PST on Tue Feb 24 works for our team — I'm checking Tessa's calendar but she confirmed tentatively offline. I'll send a calendar invite once I hear back from Monica for the recorder/notes.

Agenda update (60m):
- 0–10m: Introductions & goals
- 10–25m: Your pipeline & where model serving slots in (Harper)
- 25–45m: Live blueprints: runtime topology, VPC peering example, firewall considerations (Tessa)
- 45–55m: Cost/latency tradeoffs, batching strategy (Monica)
- 55–60m: Next steps / mutual action items (Rishi)

I'll include sample network diagrams and an example VPC peering checklist in the invite. Calendar link (placeholder): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-aqua-5421-20260224

If anything changes on your side, flag here and we can pivot to Wed.

Rishi

- Can you share a high-level network diagram (VPCs, subnets, any transit gateways) so I can mark where endpoints would sit?
- Do you have an internal IP allowlist or strict egress requirements we should know about?
